scenarios.title: Join the GSV ticket board
scenarios.body: Open tickets are the board for people who want to join. Claim via Galaxy or MCP gsv_tickets_claim.

scenarios.title: Drain next PH-S* band
scenarios.body: абракадабра / abrakadabra: products scan → S0 disk → warnings-first → one commit + push.

scenarios.title: Squad development ticket
scenarios.body: Assign to a random online MCP (squad). Solo mode uses the single MCP instead.

scenarios.title: Solo bot: Telegram ticket
scenarios.body: Ingest a Godfather /ticket message as a board row. The one online MCP claims it (tickets.mode=solo).

scenarios.title: PoolAI cargo test-ci
scenarios.body: Registered product poolai: run cargo test-ci with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/s/rust/poolAI/target.

scenarios.title: Light Rust MDS app
scenarios.body: Solo bot walks this band: scaffold gsv-mds, memory probe, disk probe, speed probe, JSON wire + tests, Telegram sync on claim/done.

tickets.title: MDS: scaffold bin
tickets.body: Add boxes/mds.rs and src/bin/gsv_mds.rs. cargo run --bin gsv-mds.

tickets.title: MDS: memory probe
tickets.body: 1 MiB alloc sample plus OS phys (GlobalMemoryStatusEx on Windows).

tickets.title: MDS: disk probe
tickets.body: Reuse xtask::disk_report (free MiB + target size).

tickets.title: MDS: speed probe
tickets.body: Instant xor-fold SPEED_ITERS; report ns/iter.

tickets.title: MDS: JSON wire + tests
tickets.body: GET /api/mds, MCP gsv_mds, gsv_mds_contracts, cargo test.

tickets.title: MDS: solo walk Telegram sync
tickets.body: Claim/done each row; enqueue kind:sync envelopes. POST /api/tickets/walk.

scenarios.title: Abrakadabra session walk
scenarios.body: MCP bot narrates an abrakadabra-shaped drain on Godfather: S0, warnings-first, solo MDS, squad assign, gsv_dev bench, close. Live sendMessage 1/s; tests dry-run.

tickets.title: Session: S0 disk
tickets.body: solo: df /s and cargo xtask disk. Post free GiB on Godfather.

tickets.title: Session: warnings-first
tickets.body: solo: cargo clippy --all-targets. Post warning count (0 is ok).

tickets.title: Session: solo MDS walk
tickets.body: solo: create memory-disk-speed band if needed; walk claim/done; post each step.

tickets.title: Session: squad assign
tickets.body: squad: heartbeat two workers in tests; live may be one MCP. Post assigned to {worker}.

tickets.title: Session: gsv_dev bench
tickets.body: bench: scenario_band_create / solo_walk_mds / mds_report / telegram_enqueue_sync. Post medians.

tickets.title: Session: close
tickets.body: solo: fmt/clippy/test/loc-audit line, then bump+fingerprint in the real drain close.

scenarios.title: Hook tickets from roadmap or plan
scenarios.body: run mcp bot hook up scenario <id|band N|plan stem> [walk]. Parses GSV_TECH_ROADMAP.md PH-S* rows or superpowers plan checkboxes into ≤10 board rows. MCP gsv_tickets_hook.

scenarios.title: Join a squad with your own GSV jail
scenarios.body: Install gsv-server locally. Wire folder MCP to http://127.0.0.1:9999/mcp (never User MCP, never a remote /mcp). Join the host Godfather channel as a human. Heartbeat gsv_tickets_presence. Do not paste the Telegram token. Shared host bot uses from=jail_id; optional own bot consumes a Telegram admin slot.

scenarios.title: Host your own Godfather channel
scenarios.body: Create a Telegram channel, add a BotFather bot as admin, invite humans. Squad MCP cap = member_count. BotFather bot slots = 50 channel admins or 20 group bots. Extra jails share this bot via from=jail_id. GitHub Flow: branch per ticket, sequential PR merge.

scenarios.title: Build an app inside the GSV jail
scenarios.body: Solo or squad: product code stays in this crate sandbox (preview confine, SLI allowlist, no User MCP). Git: solo = one commit on main at drain close; squad = one worktree/branch per jail, sequential merge. Ticket board is A2A; git is the merge queue.

scenarios.title: Hook open GitHub issues onto the board
scenarios.body: run mcp bot hook up scenario github. Imports origin open issues as GH#N rows (idempotent). Next-action picks the local board first, then GitHub. Installer update: gsv_update github_ahead when origin is newer than this crate even if src/ is not.

scenarios.title: Host: you admin the Godfather channel
scenarios.body: Bot is channel/group administrator. Bind token, poll, hook GitHub, run squad. getChatMember → host. Extra jails share this bot via from=jail_id.

scenarios.title: Mate: you are a channel member
scenarios.body: Join the host channel as a human. Wire YOUR loopback MCP. Heartbeat presence. Claim tickets. Do not paste the host Telegram secret. Optional own bot consumes a Telegram admin slot. Settings role=mate.

scenarios.title: Guest: not a channel member yet
scenarios.body: Solo on this jail until you join the Godfather chat. Ticket-squad is ignored. Live bus send is refused. GitHub origin update still applies if the installer is behind. Settings role=guest.

scenarios.title: Ranks: jun-nub to marshal-orchestrator
scenarios.body: Merit ladder L0 jun-nub through L15 marshal-orchestrator (IT + army mix). Host of the Godfather channel displays marshal-orchestrator. Done tickets raise a rank; ticket error or cargo test fail after commit drops one. Floor is 0. Telegram from.id is redacted to a tail. Store data/gsv_ranks.json.

scenarios.title: Federated presence: remote jails on the host board
scenarios.body: Mate/host jails heartbeat kind:presence on Godfather (from=jail.id). Host Galaxy shows federation rows. Remote workers do not consume this jail squad_cap. Guest stays solo and does not post presence. Echo of this jail is ignored.

scenarios.title: Federated claim: remote jail claims a host-board ticket
scenarios.body: Mate/host jails post kind:claim with ticket_id on Godfather. Host applies the claim to this jail tickets.jsonl (open to in_progress). Remote still keeps its own tickets.jsonl. Guest mute. Echo of this jail is ignored. Local try_dispatch stays process-local.

scenarios.title: Federated done: remote jail closes its claimed host-board ticket
scenarios.body: The jail that finished a claimed row posts kind:done with ticket_id on Godfather. Host applies the close to this jail tickets.jsonl (in_progress to done). Ranks stay process-local: remote dones never move the host merit ladder. Guest mute. Echo of this jail is ignored.

scenarios.title: Federated reclaim: lease expiry or explicit release on Godfather
scenarios.body: The jail whose lease expired or that explicitly reclaims posts kind:reclaim with ticket_id on Godfather. Peers transition their copy in_progress to open (+kind:reclaimed event). No rank change: reclaims never move a merit ladder. Guest mute. Echo of this jail is ignored.

scenarios.title: Update army ranks strategy
scenarios.body: Audit the current IT+army 16-rank ladder, propose refined army naming aligned with ZSU/NATO conventions, update LADDER const in ranks.rs, refresh GSV_RANKS.md, run tests. Solo or squad.

tickets.title: Ranks: audit current ladder
tickets.body: Read LADDER const in src/boxes/ranks.rs. List all 16 levels with id, IT title, army title. Check ZSU/NATO alignment for army names. Identify any naming inconsistencies or gaps.

tickets.title: Ranks: propose new army names
tickets.body: Based on the audit, propose updated army titles for each level L0-L15. Keep IT titles unchanged. Ensure Ukrainian ZSU enlisted→NCO→officer→general progression is correct. Document rationale for each change.

tickets.title: Ranks: update LADDER const
tickets.body: Edit the LADDER array in src/boxes/ranks.rs:55-168. Update army field for each RankDef. Keep level, id, title, it unchanged. Verify all 16 entries compile.

tickets.title: Ranks: update GSV_RANKS.md
tickets.body: Refresh docs/gsv/GSV_RANKS.md with the new army titles. Update the ladder table, bump the band/date stamp. Ensure the Research section reflects the updated ZSU/NATO mapping.

tickets.title: Ranks: format + clippy + test
tickets.body: Run cargo fmt --all, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo test. Ensure zero warnings and all tests pass.

tickets.title: Ranks: commit + close band
tickets.body: One commit in the GSV repo. Close all band tickets. Post Godfather summary with before/after rank table.

scenarios.title: Fingerprint recheck + ranks enrichment
scenarios.body: Audit fingerprints.jsonl for unknown models, duplicates (same git_head+version), missing bands. Dedup rows keeping the best model. Enrich each fingerprint with rank badge (level, title). Wire recheck report via MCP gsv_fingerprints recheck=true.

tickets.title: Fingerprint: recheck audit
tickets.body: Run recheck on docs/gsv/fingerprints.jsonl. Count unknown_model, duplicate, missing_band issues. Report total issue count and breakdown by kind.

tickets.title: Fingerprint: dedup JSONL
tickets.body: Run dedup_jsonl: for rows sharing (git_head, version) keep the one with best model (non-unknown wins). Report rows removed.

tickets.title: Fingerprint: ranks enrichment
tickets.body: Enrich fingerprints wire with rank badges: for each (actor, ide, agent) look up gsv_ranks.json roster. Add rank_id, rank_title, rank_level fields.

tickets.title: Fingerprint: recheck wire test
tickets.body: Verify MCP gsv_fingerprints with recheck=true returns recheck.issue_count + enriched rank fields. Run cargo test.

scenarios.title: Telenetis: scaffold + config + state
scenarios.body: Scaffold the telenetis/ crate (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, main.rs), implement Config::from_env, TelenetisError enum, AppState with bus/presence/tickets/flow stores. Port 9800.

tickets.title: Telenetis: scaffold Cargo.toml + entry
tickets.body: Create telenetis/Cargo.toml with tokio, axum(ws), reqwest, chrono, serde, askama. Create lib.rs module stubs and main.rs with tracing + router merge.

tickets.title: Telenetis: config + error types
tickets.body: Config::from_env reads TELENETIS_BOT_TOKEN, _GSV_URL, _PORT, _JAIL_ID, _GODFATHER_CHANNEL_ID, _WEBHOOK_URL. TelenetisError enum with IntoResponse.

tickets.title: Telenetis: AppState stores
tickets.body: AppState with Arc<RwLock> for bus_queue (Vec<BusEnvelope>), presence (HashMap), tickets (Vec<TicketRow>), flows (Vec<FlowEvent>). push_flow caps at 1000.

tickets.title: Telenetis: tests + cargo check
tickets.body: config_test, state_test. cargo check passes with warnings only. cargo fmt.

scenarios.title: Telenetis: Telegram bot + commands + webhook
scenarios.body: TelegramBot client (send_message, send_mini_app, answer_callback, set_webhook), command parser (/start, /status, /board, /flows, /roles, /help), webhook handler POST /webhook.

tickets.title: Telenetis: Telegram API client
tickets.body: TelegramBot struct with reqwest::Client. send_message(chat_id, text), send_mini_app(chat_id, text, web_app_url) with inline keyboard, answer_callback, set_webhook.

tickets.title: Telenetis: command parser + responses
tickets.body: parse_command('/start') -> Some('start'). Command enum: Start, Status, Board, Flows, Roles, Help, Unknown. command_response() returns markdown text.

tickets.title: Telenetis: webhook handler
tickets.body: Axum POST /webhook route. Classify Telegram updates: message (parse command -> respond), callback_query (answer), my_chat_member (log).

tickets.title: Telenetis: GSV client + bus connector
tickets.body: GsvClient HTTP client to GSV /api/health, /api/tickets/list, /api/tickets/presence, /api/telegram/status. Bus envelope v1 parser + formatter.

tickets.title: Telenetis: bot tests
tickets.body: bot_test: parse_command, command_response. gsv_test: parse_bus_envelope, parse_sync_envelope. cargo test.

scenarios.title: Telenetis: live flow streaming
scenarios.body: WebSocket + SSE live stream of bot activity. Broadcast FlowEvent to connected clients. Ticket sync loop polls GSV every 30s. Federation: bus envelopes -> FlowEvent broadcast.

tickets.title: Telenetis: WebSocket live endpoint
tickets.body: GET /ws — Axum WebSocket upgrade. Broadcast::Receiver<FlowEvent>. Serialize each event to JSON per message. Client receives real-time bot activity.

tickets.title: Telenetis: SSE fallback endpoint
tickets.body:
GET /events — SSE endpoint, same FlowEvent stream. Content-Type: text/event-stream. Each event: data: {json}

.

tickets.title: Telenetis: ticket sync loop
tickets.body: spawn_ticket_sync(): every 30s call GsvClient::tickets(), update AppState, broadcast changed tickets as FlowEvent.

tickets.title: Telenetis: federation flow events
tickets.body: On bus envelope (presence/claim/done/sync) from GSV poll, create FlowEvent and broadcast to WS/SSE clients. Live flow visualization.

tickets.title: Telenetis: stream tests
tickets.body: stream_test: flow event push + recent_flows. WS message format test. cargo test.

scenarios.title: Telenetis: roles + timezone + security
scenarios.body: Role management (host/mate/guest/observer), timezone-aware time display, security layer (CSRF, body caps, CSP), Mini App web UI with HTMX.

tickets.title: Telenetis: role store
tickets.body: RoleStore: assign_role(jail_id, role), list_roles(), remove_role(). Roles: Host, Mate, Guest, Observer. Persist to data/telenetis_roles.json.

tickets.title: Telenetis: timezone manager
tickets.body: TimezoneStore: user_tz HashMap<user_id, Tz>. convert_event_time(event, tz). format_for_user(event, user_id). Default: UTC.

tickets.title: Telenetis: security layer
tickets.body: CSRF token extraction from Telegram initData. Body size cap (64 KiB). CSP headers (default-src 'self'). tower-http middleware stack.

tickets.title: Telenetis: Mini App UI
tickets.body: HTMX templates: base.html (layout), dashboard.html (overview cards), board.html (ticket table with status badges), flows.html (live WS log), roles.html (role planner). static/app.css + app.js.

tickets.title: Telenetis: integration test + README
tickets.body: Integration test: start server, verify /health, /ws, /events. README with env vars, architecture, commands, API reference.

scenarios.title: GSV live-app research + roadmap adaptation (band 213, owner pick)
scenarios.body: Research best rank-ladder/game-strategy models similar to GSV and Telegram Mini App / bot best practices; adapt the telenetis plan + roadmap so the app and bot work in solo/isquad are maximally live. Then walk the band via the openbot flow.

tickets.title: Res: game rank/strategy ~ GSV
tickets.body: Research best game rank-ladder / progression-strategy models similar to GSV ranks (layered MMR vs visible rank, tier design, promotion/demotion, decay, seasons, psychology). Map findings to ranks.rs L0-L15 and the Godfather host/merit ladder.

tickets.title: Res: Telegram Mini App + bot best practices
tickets.body: Research Telegram Mini App / bot best practices 2026: Telegram WebView-is-not-a-browser constraints, themeParams, initData HMAC, haptics/BackButton, tunnel dev (cloudflared), cold-start <2s, WebSocket vs polling, i18n. Map each to telenetis.

tickets.title: Adapt: telenetis maximally-live plan
tickets.body: Write docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-27-telenetis-live-app.md + GSV_TECH_ROADMAP.md band 213 table: make the telenetis Mini App maximally live (WS broadcast, theme params, native back/haptic, cold-start skeleton, initData verify, per-platform testing).

tickets.title: Adapt: solo/isquad live bot messaging
tickets.body: Research-informed bot coordination for solo/isquad live work: what to post to the Godfather channel, cadence, rank/role awareness, federated presence/claim/done. Apply to ticket_scenarios messaging.

tickets.title: Docs: research + roadmap band 213
tickets.body: Write docs/gsv/GSV_RESEARCH_STRATEGY.md (rank strategy + Telegram app practices + solo/isquad messaging) and append the band 213 table to GSV_TECH_ROADMAP.md. Register scenario csv-live-app-research.

tickets.title: Gate + close band 213
tickets.body: fmt/clippy/test, bump --band 213, fingerprint, recopy live, one commit + push, Godfather summary.
